sloka: त्वत्समीपे च ये सत्त्वा वासमेष्यन्ति तां निशाम् ।अवध्याः पांसुवर्षेण ते भविष्यन्ति नित्यदा ।। ७.८१.१५ ॥
transliteration: tvatsamīpe ca ye sattvā vāsameṣyanti tāṁ niśām ।avadhyāḥ pāṁsuvarṣeṇa te bhaviṣyanti nityadā ।। 7.81.15 ॥

translations.english: And those beings who come to dwell near you for that night will always be invulnerable to the shower of dust.
